mods.name: Sinon
mods.author: Raijin
mods.description: A utility mod that adds a hotbar quick-select and auto-pickup toggles.
mods.long_description:
Sinon brings console-style quality-of-life controls to Swordigo: a quick-select hotbar, automatic loot pickup for togglable item classes, and a lightweight HUD showing collected gems in the current run. Fully configurable from the in-game pause menu.

Compatible with the latest Swordigo build and all popular content packs.

mods.name: Aetherblade
mods.author: Emberforge
mods.description: Adds the legendary Aetherblade weapon with a new swing trail and elemental proc.
mods.long_description:
Forge the Aetherblade from starlight shards found in the Skybound Ruins. This content mod adds a new weapon type with an animated energy trail, a charged heavy attack with area knockback, and a subtle idle particle effect.

NOTE: requires the Swordigo 1.4+ combat framework.

mods.name: Darkfall Citadel
mods.author: VesperWorks
mods.description: A sprawling dark-fantasy map with 3 boss arenas, secrets and lore tablets.
mods.long_description:
Darkfall Citadel is a full custom map spanning five regions: the Wailing Depths, Ash Halls, Rookery, Black Vault and the final Citadel Spire. Includes three unique boss fights with telegraphed attack patterns, 40+ secrets and readable lore tablets throughout.

Save anywhere — the map integrates with the launcher's save system.

mods.name: Crit Lines
mods.author: PixelBloom
mods.description: Stylized critical-hit lines, damage numbers and hit-stop feedback.
mods.long_description: Crit Lines replaces the default hit feedback with responsive white-outlined crit strokes, floating damage numbers (toggleable), and a subtle hit-stop on heavy impacts. Pure visual polish — no gameplay changes.

mods.name: Oren's Soundpack
mods.author: OrenAudio
mods.description: Re-mastered combat and ambient audio with spatial echo.
mods.long_description: A complete audio overhaul: re-mastered sword impacts, spell casts, enemy death sounds and region ambience with light spatial echo. All assets are original recordings — no copyrighted material.

mods.name: Gem HUD
mods.author: KiteCat
mods.description: Live gem counter, run timer and best-run tracker on the HUD.
mods.long_description: Gem HUD adds a slim always-visible HUD strip with your current gem count, a per-run timer and your best-run time for the active region. Records are stored per-mod-instance and survive restarts.

mods.name: Skybound Ruins
mods.author: Emberforge
mods.description: Floating-island region with wind currents and a grapple mechanic.
mods.long_description: Skybound Ruins adds a vertical floating-island region with wind current puzzles, a grapple-and-swing traversal mechanic and the optional Aetherblade questline. Includes 12 new enemy variants and a sky shrine boss.

mods.name: ComboFlux
mods.author: Raijin
mods.description: Combo multiplier with directional finishers and dodge-cancel timing.
mods.long_description: ComboFlux reworks the melee flow: chain attacks to build a multiplier, cancel into directional finishers on perfect dodge timing, and earn bonus gems for clean no-hit segments. Fully reversible — uninstalling restores the original combat.

mods.name: Palette Plus
mods.author: NovaGfx
mods.description: Optional color-grading presets: Vivid, Film, Dawn and Mono.
mods.long_description: Palette Plus ships four shader-free color-grade presets that shift the world palette without touching gameplay: Vivid (saturated), Film (teal-and-orange), Dawn (warm golden) and Mono (classic grayscale). Cycle them live from the launcher.

mods.name: Stormforged Gauntlets
mods.author: VesperWorks
mods.description: Gauntlet weapons with chain-lightning chained hits and shock procs.
mods.long_description: Stormforged Gauntlets add a fast gauntlet weapon family with chain-lightning on the third hit, a short-range shockwave ground slam and a passive shock proc against wet enemies. Pairs well with the Skybound region.
